newsitem.title: USA: Kerr-McGee Bohai appraisal tests 4,100 bpd.
newsitem.headline: Kerr-McGee Bohai appraisal tests 4,100 bpd.

text.p: Kerr-McGee Corp said the CFD 2-1-2 appraisal well in the Gulf of Bohai, China, tested at a rate of 4,100 barrels of light oil per day.
This well is located in contract area 04/36 in water depth of 45 feet and was drilled to a total depth of 13,120 feet. It was tested in a zone between 11,230 feet to 11,293 feet.

"Although a second appraisal well will be drilled this year, we are encouraged by our success to date," said chief executive Luke Corbett. "In addition, our 1997 plans in the Bohai area include two exploratory wells on adjacent blocks, one of which is currently drilling."

Kerr-McGee is operator of the contract area with a 45 percent interest. Murphy Oil Corp also has a 45 percent stake, while Sino-American Energy Corp, a majority-owned subsidiary of Pendaries Petroleum Ltd, has 10 percent.
